content: It’s almost time for the Made by Google keynote, where the company will show off the brand-new Pixel hardware it announced today. Like last year, it’ll be a celebrity-packed live show, though Trevor Noah is hosting instead of Jimmy Fallon. If the 2025 show was any indication, today’s broadcast might be something of a cringefest. If you’ve been following tech news this morning, you already know a lot about the new Pixels. Press and creators were able to publish extensive hands-on impressions of the new hardware hours ago, and you can read our coverage of the Pixel 11 phones, their new camera features, the Pixel Watch 5, and more right now. Google could pull something unexpected out of a hat. But it seems more likely that this show isn’t for the people who devour every hands-on the moment they’re published. Instead, the event is likely intended to reach a more mainstream audience that might watch the livestream after work or as a replay at a later time. Victoria Song will be there in person, while the rest of us will be watching remotely, and we’ll all be blogging all of our secondhand embarrassment right here. Things kick off at 6PM ET / 3PM PT. You can watch the event on the embedded YouTube video while following along with our live thoughts below. [Media: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=c84y9gAY90c]

chineseContent: 马上就要到 Made by Google 主题演讲了，该公司将在会上展示其今天宣布的全新 Pixel 硬件。和去年一样，这将是一场名人云集的现场表演，不过主持人是特雷弗·诺亚 (Trevor Noah)，而不是吉米·法伦 (Jimmy Fallon)。如果 2025 年的节目有任何迹象的话，那么今天的节目可能会让人感到畏缩。如果您今天早上一直在关注科技新闻，那么您已经对新款 Pixel 有了很多了解。媒体和创作者在几个小时前就发布了新硬件的大量实际体验，您现在可以阅读我们对 Pixel 11 手机、其新相机功能、Pixel Watch 5 等的报道。谷歌可能会从帽子里变出意想不到的东西。但更有可能的是，这个节目不适合那些在出版后立即投入所有实践的人。相反，该活动可能旨在吸引更主流的观众，他们可能会在下班后观看直播或稍后重播。宋茜将亲自到场，而我们其他人将远程观看，我们都会在这里写下我们所有的二手尴尬。活动于东部时间下午 6 点/太平洋时间下午 3 点开始。您可以在嵌入的 YouTube 视频上观看该活动，同时关注下面我们的实时想法。 [媒体：https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=c84y9gAY90c]
